paper_title: DARWIN: towards the ultimate dark matter detector
notes: DARWIN projection paper. Figure 4 shows sensitivity projections for solar axions (g_Ae^solar vs m_A) and galactic ALPs (g_Ae^ALP vs m_A) via the axio-electric effect, constraining the axion-electron coupling. The DARWIN projection improves galactic ALP sensitivity by ~2 orders of magnitude over XENON100 and solar axion sensitivity by ~1 order of magnitude. However, no numerical table or explicit DARWIN sensitivity values are given in the text — only the figure (not extractable to numbers here). XENON100 reference limits quoted: g_Ae^ALP ~2e-12 (90% CL, 1-40 keV galactic ALPs), g_Ae^solar > 7.7e-12 (90% CL). These are prior XENON100 results, not new DARWIN limits. The local DM density rho_0=0.3 GeV/cm^3 is assumed for the WIMP halo. Coupling type is AxionElectron but no extractable DARWIN data points available.
